# fixture vault — a writing vault

Shared behaviour and rules for every work in this vault. Each work has its own
directory with its own QWEN.md that adds the rules for that work. Both apply;
where they conflict, the work's file wins.

## Prose rules that apply everywhere

The full guide with examples is `style/prose.md`; the list of things that make text
read as machine-written is `style/anti-tells.md`.

## Vault layout

    QWEN.md          this file: shared behaviour and rules
    style/           prose.md, anti-tells.md: the shared style guide
    novels/<slug>/   long-form; bible/, research/, outline/, chapters/, continuity.md, notes/
